title: vaccinium vitis-idaea f. minus
intro: Vaccinium vitis-idaea f. minus, commonly known as dwarf bilberry or lesser bilberry, is a plant species belonging to the heath family and is closely related to the cranberry and blueberry. It is native to the Arctic tundra and alpine regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. The health benefits of Vaccinium vitis-idaea f. minus include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that may help to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and support cognitive function.
